name: Muneeb Asad
bio: Founded Wysetech Technologies with a mission to bring enterprise-grade IT security and automation to growing businesses. Drives strategic direction, client partnerships, and overall company vision.

name: Ahmad Raza
bio: Architects Wysetech's entire infrastructure stack. Specialises in CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and Infrastructure-as-Code. Believes everything that can be automated should be.

name: Sara Khan
bio: Leads all security operations — from SIEM deployment and threat hunting to compliance readiness. Holds OSCP and CEH certifications. Previously worked in red team engagements for financial institutions.

name: Hassan Ali
bio: Designs and maintains LAN, WAN, and cloud network topologies for client environments. Certified Cisco and Juniper professional with deep expertise in SNMP monitoring, VPNs, and firewall policy management.

name: Zainab Malik
bio: Manages the helpdesk function and ensures SLA compliance across all client tiers. Focused on delivering human-first IT support with measurable outcomes. Trains junior engineers and refines support workflows.

name: Usman Tariq
bio: Responsible for backup strategy design, disaster recovery planning, and endpoint patch management. Ensures every client has a verified, tested recovery path — not just a backup that's never been restored.
